name: CDC Maddington Campus (DC4)
notes: CDC Maddington Campus at 307 Kenwick Rd, Maddington (City of Gosnells), determined under WA DAP reference DAP/25/02926 (per AU methodology; City of Gosnells DAP). $415M first-stage, ~200 MW ultimate campus per trade press - capacity basis is ultimate campus capacity, not initial IT load. No official DAP determination record opened; grade B pending primary record.
